svg.title: Readiness to replace Three.js in real applications
svg.desc: Six prospective adoption gates. Early evidence is not qualification. The current project is a research prototype, not a qualified replacement. Source translation counts are separate.

g.text: Goal: worthwhile performance with little application change
Research prototype — Not yet qualified as a Three.js replacement
NOW: Prototype → NEXT: Useful accelerator → GOAL: Application replacement
Useful app-level speed
Early evidence
20% and 1 ms less CPU time at p50 and p95
One scaled asset; no app qualification yet
A reason to choose Rust
Not yet
10% and 0.5 ms beyond the matched JS design
Independent Rust benefit remains unproven
Low migration cost
Early evidence
Import, preparation and resolution changes only
Owned animation still needs explicit migration
Preserved app behavior
Early evidence
Same features, interaction and visual quality
Finite rig correctness; broad app contract open
Bounded total cost
Not yet
Control, startup, download and memory budgets
Lifecycle and whole-product budgets unqualified
Repeatable supported release
Early evidence
Two hardware classes and browser engines
One Mac experiment; no qualified release yet
Early evidence ≠ gate met. Qualified requires a reviewed application-level report.
Targets for future qualification — not measured promises, API coverage or a completion percentage.
